intent: Propose Horizon as a reusable Shoreline theme for AI Workspace, Studio and design-team templates or prototypes, with explicit global CSS entrypoints and foundation tokens. This is the initial RFC v1.0 proposal; the branch demonstrates capabilities pending review.

impact.summary: Horizon proposes an alternative global theme sharing reset, base and component styles through CSS imports and extending token values. Theme composition, semantic vocabulary and consumer adoption are explicit inputs to review. Experimental component-specific tokens demonstrate scoped decisions; shared API examples and their limits are recorded in component contracts for both themes.
impact.consumerAction: Select @vtex/shoreline/themes/horizon as the complete stylesheet for the document, or use its split exports with the declared layer order. Use one complete global theme per document.

openQuestions: Which components and states form the first complete visual acceptance matrix for Horizon?

evidence.description: Verify composed token declarations and local import dependencies.
Record a complete package build followed by the CSS export verifier.
Review Horizon Show stories in an isolated Storybook document.
Validate contrast, visible focus and representative keyboard journeys in Horizon.
Review the target theme and imported shared styles across its agreed component matrix.
